key_insight: LiteOdyssey shows that a single lightweight AI agent, guided by a diagnostic policy and public biomedical tools, can reach strong rare-disease diagnosis performance without heavy scaling.
clinical_relevance: For clinicians, this suggests a more deployable and interpretable AI workflow for rare-disease case review that could support physician decision-making rather than replace it.
method: Built a diagnostic policy through Policy Iteration with Human Feedback (PIHF).
Guided one reasoning language model through a clinical genetics workflow.
Enabled dynamic use of freely available biomedical tools instead of fine-tuning or large retrieval systems.
evidence_signal: Across 1,243 benchmark cases from LIRICAL and PhenoPacket Store, LiteOdyssey achieved 59.3% Recall@1 overall, and 60.7% on a harder PhenoPacket subset versus 10.7% for the same base model without tools.
watch_item: Results come from benchmark and cohort evaluations, so real-world performance, workflow integration, and auditability still need careful prospective validation.
paper_title: LiteOdyssey: A Lightweight Reasoning AI Agent for Interpretable Rare-Disease Diagnosis
